_dataset_note: 45 real, well-established central government schemes, selected to span the categories required by the problem statement (agriculture, rural development, women, youth, education, MSME, street vendors, artisans, financial inclusion, social security, housing, disability, livelihoods, health). Scheme names, ministries, and general eligibility/benefit shapes are accurate as of the author's general knowledge and cross-checked against aggregator listings during this session. EXACT current eligibility figures, benefit amounts, and URLs were NOT individually re-verified against myscheme.gov.in for every record in the time available -- do this before final submission, especially for amounts (these are revised periodically in the Union Budget). Where the exact ministry portal URL was not confidently known, source_url points to myScheme's official listing, which is itself a Government of India platform (Digital India Corporation, MeitY). last_verified is left null throughout -- do not present it as verified until your team has actually checked it.

schemes.name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.description: Direct income support to farmer families to help meet input costs for agriculture and allied activities.
schemes.benefits: Cash transfer paid in three equal installments per year directly to the farmer's bank account.
eligibility: Farmer family owning cultivable land
Subject to exclusion criteria (income-tax payers, institutional landholders, holders of constitutional posts, etc. are excluded)
application_process: Register online via the PM-KISAN portal
Or apply through the local Common Service Centre (CSC) / patwari / revenue officer

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.description: Crop insurance scheme protecting farmers against yield loss from natural calamities, pests, and diseases.
schemes.benefits: Low, uniform premium rate; insurance cover from pre-sowing to post-harvest losses.
eligibility: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas
Includes sharecroppers and tenant farmers
application_process: Through banks, insurance companies, CSCs, or the PMFBY online portal within the notified enrollment window for each crop season

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.description: Provides farmers with timely access to affordable short-term credit for cultivation and other needs.
schemes.benefits: Revolving credit at concessional interest rates, covering crop production, post-harvest expenses, and allied activities.
eligibility: Farmers, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, and self-help group members engaged in agriculture or allied activities
application_process: Apply at any participating bank branch or via the bank's online portal

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Jal Shakti / Ministry of Agriculture
schemes.description: Improves farm-level irrigation access and water-use efficiency ('Har Khet Ko Pani').
schemes.benefits: Financial assistance for micro-irrigation (drip/sprinkler) and irrigation infrastructure.
eligibility: Farmers, farmer groups, and cooperatives investing in irrigation infrastructure on their land
application_process: Apply through the state agriculture/horticulture department or the PMKSY portal

schemes.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.description: Provides farmers with soil nutrient status and crop-wise fertilizer/nutrient recommendations.
schemes.benefits: Free soil testing and a personalized soil health card every cycle.
eligibility: All farmers with agricultural land are eligible to request a soil test
application_process: Contact the local Krishi Vigyan Kendra or state agriculture department for soil sample collection

schemes.name: Jal Jeevan Mission
schemes.description: Aims to provide functional household tap water connections to every rural household.
schemes.benefits: Piped drinking water connection to the household.
eligibility: Rural households without an existing functional tap water connection
documents: Household registration with the local Gram Panchayat
application_process: Apply through the local Gram Panchayat / Village Water and Sanitation Committee

schemes.name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
schemes.description: Legal guarantee of at least 100 days of wage employment per year to rural households willing to do unskilled manual work.
schemes.benefits: Guaranteed wage employment on public works at the notified wage rate.
eligibility: Adult members of a rural household willing to do unskilled manual work, registered with the local Gram Panchayat
application_process: Register with the local Gram Panchayat to obtain a job card, then apply for work as needed

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)
schemes.description: Provides all-weather road connectivity to unconnected rural habitations.
schemes.benefits: Construction of all-weather roads connecting eligible rural habitations.
eligibility: Unconnected rural habitations above the population threshold notified for the state/region
documents: Not applicable to individuals -- habitation-level infrastructure scheme
application_process: Proposed and prioritized through the state Rural Roads Department / Gram Panchayat

schemes.name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
schemes.description: Awareness and welfare programme addressing declining child sex ratio and promoting the education and empowerment of the girl child.
schemes.benefits: Community awareness activities and convergence with related girl-child welfare and education schemes.
eligibility: Programme benefits are largely community/district-level; individual convergence benefits depend on linked schemes (e.g. Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana)
application_process: Implemented through district administrations; individual benefits accessed via linked schemes
schemes.source_name: Ministry of Women and Child Development

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
schemes.description: Maternity benefit programme providing cash incentives to pregnant and lactating women for the first living child.
schemes.benefits: Cash incentive disbursed in installments, conditional on health check-ups and immunization milestones.
eligibility: Pregnant and lactating women for their first living child (with some extension for second child if a girl, per current guidelines)
Excludes women in regular government employment receiving equivalent benefits
documents: Pregnancy/health records from an Anganwadi centre or health facility
application_process: Register at the local Anganwadi centre or approved health facility, or via the PMMVY portal/app

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
schemes.description: Small savings scheme for the girl child, offering a government-backed high-interest savings account.
schemes.benefits: Government-backed savings account with a competitive interest rate, maturing when the girl turns 21.
eligibility: Girl child below 10 years of age, account opened by a parent or legal guardian
application_process: Open an account at any post office or authorized bank branch

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY 2.0)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
schemes.description: Provides free LPG gas connections to women from below-poverty-line and other eligible households.
schemes.benefits: Free LPG connection with first refill and stove, subsidized subsequent refills.
eligibility: Adult woman from a below-poverty-line or otherwise notified eligible household without an existing LPG connection
application_process: Apply through the nearest LPG distributor or the PMUY portal

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
schemes.description: Flagship skill certification scheme offering short-term training and certification to youth.
schemes.benefits: Free short-term skill training, certification, and a placement-linked opportunity; monetary reward on successful assessment for some batches.
eligibility: Indian youth, typically school/college dropouts or unemployed individuals seeking skill certification
application_process: Register at a nearby PMKVY training centre or via the Skill India Digital portal

schemes.name: Skill India Digital
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
schemes.description: Unified digital platform for skilling, upskilling, apprenticeships, and job opportunities.
schemes.benefits: Access to skill courses, apprenticeship listings, and job/internship opportunities in one place.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen seeking skill training, apprenticeship, or job opportunities
application_process: Register on the Skill India Digital portal

schemes.name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
schemes.description: Promotes apprenticeship training by sharing a part of the stipend cost with employers.
schemes.benefits: Stipend support during apprenticeship and structured on-the-job training leading to certification.
eligibility: Youth aged 14 years and above (varies by trade) seeking apprenticeship training with a registered establishment
application_process: Register on the apprenticeship portal and apply to a listed establishment

schemes.name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
schemes.description: Scholarship to prevent dropout after Class 8 and support continued education for meritorious students from economically weaker sections.
schemes.benefits: Annual scholarship disbursed directly to the student's bank account, renewable each year subject to performance.
eligibility: Studying in a government/government-aided/local body school, Class 9-12
Family income below the prescribed threshold
Must clear the state-level selection exam and maintain minimum marks
application_process: State-level selection exam conducted by the State Education Department; apply through school

schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.description: Financial assistance for Scheduled Caste students pursuing post-matriculation/post-secondary studies.
schemes.benefits: Maintenance allowance and reimbursement of course fees, subject to income ceiling.
eligibility: Student belongs to a Scheduled Caste
Enrolled in a post-matric course (Class 11 onward)
Family income below the prescribed ceiling
application_process: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal within the notified academic-year window

schemes.name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls
schemes.description: Scholarship supporting girl students pursuing technical education in AICTE-approved institutions.
schemes.benefits: Annual scholarship amount covering tuition and incidental expenses, for the duration of the technical course.
eligibility: Girl student admitted to a technical diploma/degree course in an AICTE-approved institution
Family income below the prescribed ceiling
Maximum two girl children per family can avail
application_process: Apply via the AICTE Pragati/Saksham scholarship portal

schemes.name: PM YASASVI Scholarship
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.description: Scholarship scheme for meritorious students from OBC, EBC, and DNT communities.
schemes.benefits: Scholarship amount for pre-matric and post-matric students, and support for entrance-exam coaching for select students.
eligibility: Student belongs to OBC/EBC/DNT category
Family income below the prescribed ceiling
Must qualify the YASASVI entrance test where applicable
application_process: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
schemes.description: Collateral-free loans to non-corporate, non-farm micro and small enterprises.
schemes.benefits: Loans across tiers (commonly referred to as Shishu, Kishor, Tarun, and Tarun Plus) up to a maximum ceiling depending on business stage.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen with a business plan for a non-farm income-generating micro/small enterprise
application_process: Apply at any participating bank, NBFC, or MFI branch, or via the Mudra portal

schemes.name: Stand-Up India
schemes.description: Bank loans to facilitate greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, trading, or agri-allied activities.
schemes.benefits: Composite loan (term loan plus working capital) within a specified range.
eligibility: SC/ST and/or woman entrepreneur above 18 years
Setting up a new (greenfield) enterprise
At least 51% shareholding/controlling stake with the eligible category
application_process: Apply through any scheduled commercial bank branch or the Stand-Up India online portal

schemes.name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
schemes.description: Provides collateral-free credit guarantee cover to lenders financing micro and small enterprises.
schemes.benefits: Enables MSMEs to access collateral-free loans up to the notified guarantee ceiling.
eligibility: New and existing micro and small enterprises (manufacturing or service) applying for eligible loans through a member lending institution
documents: Loan application documents with the lending bank/NBFC
application_process: Apply for the underlying loan through a CGTMSE member lending institution; the guarantee is availed by the lender

schemes.name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
schemes.description: Credit-linked subsidy for setting up new micro-enterprises to generate self-employment.
schemes.benefits: Margin money subsidy (varying by category and area) on a bank loan for a new micro-enterprise.
eligibility: Individuals above 18 years
Educational qualification requirement for project cost above a notified threshold
Self-help groups, trusts, and cooperatives are also eligible
application_process: Apply online via the PMEGP e-portal (KVIC)

schemes.name: PM SVANidhi
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.description: Micro-credit facility for urban street vendors to resume and grow their businesses.
schemes.benefits: Working capital loan starting small, with higher renewal amounts on timely repayment, interest subsidy, and cashback on digital transactions.
eligibility: Street vendor in possession of a Certificate of Vending / Identity Card issued by urban local bodies, or identified in a survey
application_process: Apply through the PM SVANidhi portal, participating banks, or urban local bodies

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma
schemes.description: Support for traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 notified trades through skill training, modern tools, and affordable credit.
schemes.benefits: Skill training with stipend, toolkit incentive, collateral-free loans at concessional interest, and market/digital support.
eligibility: Self-employed artisan/craftsperson engaged in one of the notified trades (e.g. carpenter, potter, weaver, cobbler) through hand tools and manual work
application_process: Register via a Common Service Centre or the PM Vishwakarma portal

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Van Dhan Yojana
schemes.description: Value addition to minor forest produce collected by tribal gatherers, through Van Dhan Vikas Kendras.
schemes.benefits: Training, common facility infrastructure, and market linkage for processing and selling minor forest produce.
eligibility: Tribal minor forest produce gatherers organized into Self-Help Groups under a Van Dhan Vikas Kendra
application_process: Enrol through the local Van Dhan Vikas Kendra, coordinated by TRIFED/state tribal welfare department

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
schemes.description: National mission for financial inclusion, providing access to a basic bank account for every household.
schemes.benefits: Zero-balance savings account, RuPay debit card, accident insurance cover, and access to overdraft facility.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen without an existing bank account
documents: Aadhaar or other valid ID/address proof
application_process: Open an account at any bank branch or Business Correspondent point

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
schemes.description: Renewable term life insurance scheme with a low annual premium.
schemes.benefits: Life insurance cover in case of death of the insured, for a modest annual premium.
eligibility: Age 18 to 50 years (cover continues till 55) with a bank/post office account and consent for auto-debit of premium
application_process: Enrol through your bank or post office account, or the Jan Suraksha portal

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
schemes.description: Renewable accident insurance scheme with a very low annual premium.
schemes.benefits: Accidental death and disability cover for a modest annual premium.
eligibility: Age 18 to 70 years with a bank/post office account and consent for auto-debit of premium
application_process: Enrol through your bank or post office account, or the Jan Suraksha portal

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
schemes.description: Guaranteed pension scheme for workers in the unorganised sector.
schemes.benefits: Fixed monthly pension after age 60, based on the contribution tier chosen.
eligibility: Age 18 to 40 years with a savings bank/post office account
Primarily targeted at unorganised sector workers not covered by a formal pension scheme
application_process: Enrol through your bank or post office account

schemes.name: e-Shram (National Database of Unorganised Workers)
schemes.description: National registry of unorganised workers, enabling access to social security schemes.
schemes.benefits: e-Shram card, accident insurance cover, and a gateway to link with other social security and welfare schemes.
eligibility: Unorganised sector workers aged 16 to 59 (e.g. construction workers, domestic workers, street vendors, agricultural labourers, gig workers)
application_process: Self-register on the e-Shram portal or through a Common Service Centre

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
schemes.description: Voluntary and contributory pension scheme for unorganised sector workers.
schemes.benefits: Fixed monthly pension after age 60, with matching government contribution.
eligibility: Unorganised sector worker aged 18-40
Monthly income within the notified ceiling
Not covered under NPS/ESIC/EPFO or as an income-tax payee
documents: Bank account (savings account or Jan Dhan account)
application_process: Register at a Common Service Centre or through the scheme's mobile app
schemes.source_name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan official portal

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.description: Affordable housing support for urban economically weaker sections and low/middle income groups.
schemes.benefits: Interest subsidy on home loans, or direct financial assistance for construction/enhancement, depending on the applicable component.
eligibility: Household should not own a pucca house anywhere in India
Falls within the notified EWS/LIG/MIG income category for the applicable component
application_process: Apply online via the PMAY-U portal or through the local urban local body

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
schemes.description: Financial assistance to rural households for construction of a pucca house.
schemes.benefits: Direct financial assistance for house construction, plus convergence with other schemes (toilet, LPG, electricity connection).
eligibility: Rural household identified as houseless or living in a kutcha/dilapidated house, per the Awaas+ survey/SECC data
application_process: Beneficiaries are identified through the Awaas+ survey; apply/verify through the Gram Panchayat

schemes.name: Deendayal Disabled Rehabilitation Scheme (DDRS)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (DEPwD)
schemes.description: Grant-in-aid support, routed through registered NGOs, for education, vocational training, and rehabilitation of persons with disabilities.
schemes.benefits: Access to special schools, vocational training centres, early intervention, and rehabilitation services run by supported NGOs.
eligibility: Person with disability as defined under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act
Accessing services through an NGO registered under the scheme
application_process: Approach an NGO registered under DDRS; check the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities portal for a list
schemes.source_name: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities

schemes.name: Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances (ADIP Scheme)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (DEPwD)
schemes.description: Provides assistive devices to persons with disabilities to improve mobility, communication, and independence.
schemes.benefits: Free or subsidized assistive devices (e.g. wheelchairs, hearing aids, calipers) depending on income category.
eligibility: Person with a certified disability of 40% or more
Family income below the notified ceiling for free/subsidized devices
Not having received the same aid from any other scheme in the last three years
application_process: Apply through an implementing agency (NGO/ALIMCO camp) empanelled under ADIP
schemes.source_name: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
schemes.description: Development of the fisheries sector covering infrastructure, production support, and livelihood assistance.
schemes.benefits: Financial assistance for boats/gear, aquaculture infrastructure, insurance, and post-harvest support; some components include safety-net assistance during fishing-ban periods.
eligibility: Individual fishers, fish farmers, fisheries cooperatives, and entrepreneurs in the fisheries value chain
Specific eligibility and subsidy share vary by sub-component and state
application_process: Apply through the State Fisheries Department or the PMMSY portal

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
schemes.description: Health insurance cover for secondary and tertiary hospitalization for economically vulnerable families.
schemes.benefits: Cashless hospitalization cover up to the notified amount per family per year at empanelled hospitals; expanded coverage for senior citizens above 70 under current guidelines.
eligibility: Families identified as deprived/occupational categories under the Socio-Economic Caste Census
Senior citizens aged 70+ (under the expanded component)
State-specific extensions may apply
application_process: Check eligibility on the PM-JAY portal or at a nearby empanelled hospital's Ayushman Mitra desk / CSC

schemes.name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
schemes.ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
schemes.description: Rooftop solar scheme enabling households to generate their own electricity and reduce power bills.
schemes.benefits: Subsidy on rooftop solar installation, aiming to give eligible households a defined number of free electricity units per month.
eligibility: Indian household with a suitable rooftop and an existing electricity connection
Willingness to install a rooftop solar unit through an empanelled vendor
application_process: Register on the PM Surya Ghar portal, select a vendor, and complete the installation and inspection process

schemes.name: Startup India
schemes.ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
schemes.description: National initiative to support and promote startups through tax benefits, funding access, and simplified compliance.
schemes.benefits: Tax exemptions (subject to conditions), access to the Fund of Funds for Startups, simplified compliance, and self-certification under certain labour/environment laws.
eligibility: Entity recognized as a 'startup' by DPIIT: incorporated as a private limited company, LLP, or partnership firm; turnover below the notified ceiling; not older than the notified age limit; working towards innovation or improvement of products/services
application_process: Apply for DPIIT recognition via the Startup India portal

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
schemes.description: Monthly pension for elderly persons belonging to below-poverty-line households, under the National Social Assistance Programme.
schemes.benefits: Monthly pension amount (central share, often topped up by states) to eligible senior citizens.
eligibility: Age 60 years or above
Belongs to a household living below the poverty line as per applicable state criteria
application_process: Apply through the local Gram Panchayat/Municipal office or the state Social Welfare Department
schemes.source_name: National Social Assistance Programme official portal

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Gramin Digital Saksharta Abhiyan (PMGDISHA)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
schemes.description: Aims to make one member of every eligible rural household digitally literate.
schemes.benefits: Free basic digital literacy training covering operating a computer/mobile device, sending emails, and using the internet.
eligibility: Rural, non-digitally-literate individuals aged 14 to 60, one per eligible household (preference to households without any digitally literate member)
documents: Household eligibility proof as notified locally
application_process: Register at a designated training centre or Common Service Centre in the village

schemes.name: National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM) / Ajeevika
schemes.description: Promotes rural self-employment and livelihoods by organizing rural poor women into self-help groups (SHGs).
schemes.benefits: Access to community institutions, revolving fund and bank-linkage credit at concessional rates, skill training, and livelihood support.
eligibility: Rural women, particularly from poor and vulnerable households, willing to join or form a Self-Help Group
application_process: Join or form an SHG through the local NRLM/state rural livelihood mission office

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana (PMVVY)
schemes.description: Pension scheme for senior citizens providing an assured return over a fixed policy term (offered in periodic tranches by LIC).
schemes.benefits: Assured pension payout (monthly/quarterly/annual, as chosen) on a lump-sum purchase price, for the policy term.
eligibility: Age 60 years and above
Subject to the scheme being open for subscription in the relevant tranche and the notified investment ceiling
application_process: Apply through LIC branches or the LIC online portal when the scheme window is open

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Vishwakarma Kaushal Samman (legacy Skill Loan Scheme reference)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
schemes.description: Facilitates collateral-free education loans for skill development courses aligned with National Skills Qualification Framework.
schemes.benefits: Collateral-free loan covering course fees for recognized skill-development and vocational training programmes.
eligibility: Indian citizen enrolled or seeking enrollment in a skill-development course aligned to the National Skills Qualification Framework
application_process: Apply through a participating bank under the Skill Loan Scheme guidelines
